notes_for_review: The paper is mainly about RL plus VR demonstrations for grasping; WSP appears only as one exploratory subsection where Claude Opus 5.5 edits Contact-GraspNet weights. That edit is a documented negative result: the model found a real structural property (all-negative final weights capping confidence at 0.294) but both edits hurt practice success and were reverted. It is a single run with no seeds, but it is a useful counterexample of LLM weight reading yielding a correct diagnosis without a performance gain.
